title: THE REIGNING BALLON D'OR WINNER JUST FINISHED SEVENTH
description:
Last year he won it. This year, in London, he came seventh. Ousmane Dembele, everyone.

Ousmane Dembele won last year's Ballon d'Or. This year he came seventh. Still top ten. In 2024-25 he scored 33 goals and made 15 assists, which are first-place numbers. Harry Kane won with 1,055 points, and Dembele had 418. Kane's total is more than double his.

Even Lionel Messi, playing in Miami, finished fifth, two places higher. Meanwhile PSG are top of Ligue 1 with 23 points after ten games, so seventh place hasn't hurt the table. They also signed Torres, Godts and Akliouche this summer. So Dembele has company.
